quest.title: A Lighthearted Feast of Magic!
quest.description: As another dance party draws to a close, everyone seems to have gained something wonderful...

talks.objective: Go to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Hey... Yah!

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: My head's already full of music — dance, dance!

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Sway, sway~

dialogues.speaker: Manaia
dialogues.text: So happy~

dialogues.speaker: Moo
dialogues.text: Krraaa!

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Made some extra money too.

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Huh? Since when?

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Nusta was swamped, so I helped out her trainees and cleared out a few monster nests.

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: In Natlan, fighting and dancing are equally exhilarating. I like it.

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Thanks for that, Marine. I wanted the rookies to get more training, but they still couldn't handle that mission on their own.

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: I'll make them train harder when we get back!

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: No need — they did great. Just didn't expect the nest to have seven times the estimated number of monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: And the Flower-Feather Clan pays pretty well. I even saved enough to get a gift for Aeval.

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: But your vacation's about over too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: A few more days, then I'll start thinking about booking the return ship.

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: No rush, we can still dance. Roxane, Letellier, Chenee, and Frejus have all been competing for jobs lately, so I won't steal their thunder.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Then let's just keep dancing and keep having fun!

dialogues.speaker: Manaia
dialogues.text: When you're tired, eat. When you're full, sleep. No worries at all!

dialogues.speaker: Moo
dialogues.text: Raargh!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Melusines and the little Koholasaurus lined up and bounced their way toward the stage.

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: What a lovely group of guests...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks like you're enjoying yourself too, Nusta.

choices.text: Your smile looks so much more relaxed now.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Really? Then I suppose I must attend every dance party from now on.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I'll make sure those kiddos who call me "ma'am" or even "auntie"... will one day realize I'm younger than them in spirit!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: And I believe future dance parties should be just like this one — if anything, they should happen more often! I'm all for making it a monthly tradition!

choices.text: And you even look a bit younger somehow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, we sure had tons of fun at the dance party!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wonders how everyone else is feeling...
